mapper.select: select * from service where id = #{id} and status = 'ON' and deleted_at is null
select * from service where id = #{id} and deleted_at is null
mapper.insert: insert into service (name, category, cover_url, price_from, duration_minutes, tags, content_items, notice, refund_policy, status, sort) values (#{name}, #{category}, #{coverUrl}, #{priceFrom}, #{durationMinutes}, #{tags}, #{contentItems}, #{notice}, #{refundPolicy}, #{status}, #{sort})
mapper.update: update service set name = #{name}, category = #{category}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, price_from = #{priceFrom}, duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, tags = #{tags}, content_items = #{contentItems}, notice = #{notice}, refund_policy = #{refundPolicy}, sort = #{sort}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and deleted_at is null
update service set status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and deleted_at is null
